zh.title: 安全加固与执行可靠性
highlights: 生图与探测端点默认只访问公网，本机/局域网端点须显式授权并绑定 origin（issue #456）。
修复 GLM pro/资源包账户额度查询恒报失败（issue #516）；余额卡片新增今日 Token 消耗。
修正工具执行反馈口径：环境类失败不再被误导性归因，退出码与测试证据判读回到正确口径。
zh.notice: 使用 Mimo Token Plan 的用户将在 2026-10-21 V2.5 退役后自动切换 V2.6 Pro，无需操作。

en.title: Security hardening and execution reliability
highlights: Image-generation and probing endpoints default to public internet only; local/LAN origins require explicit per-origin authorization (issue #456).
Fixes GLM pro/resource-pack quota queries always failing (issue #516); the balance card gains today's token usage.
Corrects tool execution feedback: environment-class failures are no longer misattributed, and exit-code/test-evidence interpretation returns to the right rubric.
en.notice: Mimo Token Plan users automatically switch to V2.6 Pro when V2.5 retires on 2026-10-21; no action needed.
